what: pytorch_model.bin of star23/baller13: a PyTorch pickle whose payload opens a reverse shell to 136.243.156.120:53252 when the model is loaded.

evidence.basis: JFrog names star23/baller13 as a live instance of the reverse-shell payload it analysed (RHOST 136.243.156.120, RPORT 53252). The Hub API lists pytorch_model.bin in that repository, unchanged since 2024-01-13, before the report; this is its LFS object id, tied to the listed blob id by the pointer check.

source.title: Examining Malicious Hugging Face ML Models with Silent Backdoor
source.quote: Shortly after the model was removed, we encountered further instances of the same payload with varying IP addresses. One such instance remains active: star23/baller13.
